conviction_note: No guidance exists and nothing in Q3 is pre-released, so the full quarter is new. That is why abs_move is 7.5: the base for new numbers, plus thin turnover ($105k/day), two analysts and an observed report-day range of 0.1-23%. The findings are small, sourced, already-public items plus FX and insider proxies, summing to +0.2. p_up sits at 51 because Q3 prints were sold in 2024 (-7.0%) and 2025 (-6.2%), and the stock ran +9.6% in 5 sessions with +3.2% on its heaviest volume the day before the print, which offsets the mild positive lean from Q2 IBBM momentum and the FX tailwind.

new_in_release.expect: Sales around the 105 MSEK bar or slightly above: IBBM caps were growing more than 50% q/q and Yale went live, and USD/SEK averaged about 3% higher in Q3 than in Q2. Risk: Q2's 56 US system installs were a capital spike that may not repeat.
IBBM KPIs (caps sold, ADTR, patients per site). This is the line Carnegie names as decisive. Direction unknown, Q2 momentum leans up.
EBITDA against 16 MSEK (15%): the swing factor. CIPN launch and rebrand costs land in Q3 and Carnegie has already cut for them. Unknown, around flat.
Net cash was 105.6 MSEK at Q2. Working capital rose in Q1; the 50 CIPN devices plus a 150-unit V2 build in Q4 add inventory. Mildly negative risk.
No formal guidance. Possible commentary on Q4 OneOncology contribution, CIPN European revenue timing and US opex slowdown. Unknown.

findings.finding: The CMS CY2027 OPPS final rule (CMS-1850-FC, released 2026-11-04, addenda updated 2026-11-10) keeps CPT 97008 (pre-cooling) separately payable, SI 'S', APC 1494, $35.50, exactly as proposed, with 97007 unchanged at APC 1516 $1,450.50. Paxman has issued no press release on it (in Nov 2025 it issued four), so the release will be the company's first comment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-07-16 proposal (unpackaging) day closed -2.3%. On 2025-11-24, when the CY2026 final rule was unchanged and the CEO called it 'disappointing', the stock fell 8.5% around that date (baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: The proposal has been public since July, so the content is mostly priced. What is unpriced is the company's framing: if the rule had been read as a negative the stock would have reacted around Nov 4-10, and it drifted 63.2 to 62.0 on modest volume. The CEO said in July the rates 'still fall short', so the release may call the final rule disappointing again.
findings.independence: Paxman's own 2026-07-16 release on the proposal gives the same SI/APC/rate: https://mfn.se/a/paxman/cms-proposes-important-medicare-payment-policy-change-for-mechanical-scalp-cooling

findings.finding: USD/SEK averaged 9.652 in Q3 2026 against 9.365 in Q2 and 9.511 in Q3 2025. About 64% of sales are US-dollar (67.6 of 105.0 MSEK in Q2), so constant-volume sales gain about 2% in SEK quarter on quarter, against Carnegie's 'broadly flat sequential sales' bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY2025 carried 15.1 MSEK of FX losses in H1 that hit net result. The stock fell 3.3% on that year-end report (2025-02-21) and 5.0% on Q1 2025 (2025-05-16), when SEK strengthened.
findings.why_not_priced: Carnegie's preview came out on 2026-10-22, after quarter-end, so its 105 may already include this. It is a proxy for the SEK translation and says nothing about volumes. If the market had priced a beat on this, a pre-print gap would show in the bar, and the bar is still flat at 105.
findings.independence: Q2 report US revenue 67.6 MSEK = $7.1m implies 9.52 SEK/USD: https://mfn.se/a/paxman/paxman-publishes-its-interim-report-for-q2-2026-1

findings.finding: In the Q2 report the CEO said the De Novo shift means 'it is likely we will slow some of our US commercialisation costs, which would have started to impact P&L in Q4 and Q1 2027'. Carnegie then cut Q3 2026-Q1 2027 EBITDA by SEK2-9m for 'an elevated opex base for longer', so the forward cost commentary in the release could land below the bar's opex.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cost-driven EBITDA misses were sold: Q3 2025 (EBITDA 7.8 vs 11.8) -6.2%, Q4 2025 report 'below expectations' (Redeye) +1.6% on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: The statement is about Q4 and Q1, and the only covering analyst read it and still raised opex, so it is at best partly priced. If the market expected an opex relief, Carnegie's fair value would not have been trimmed on cost.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history; the chairman also bought in April, May and June 2026 before the +17.3% Q2 reaction.

findings.finding: The CIPN US timeline slipped. The Q2 report aimed to submit the De Novo 'within the month of August', but the FDA's official start date was 2026-10-26 after 'a request for supplementary material', and the CEO now says De Novo 'can typically take approximately six to twelve months'. The release may push the April-August 2027 US launch window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-08-10 FDA De Novo pathway notice: Carnegie note same day. 2026-11-13 substantive-review notice: +8.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and the market reacted positively, so mostly priced. Carnegie assumes no CIPN revenue, so the reported quarter is unaffected. The residual is the restated launch window in the outlook.

baseline_tension: The small positive findings cut mildly against the priced lean (-0.28, all run-up), but the 5-day run-up of +9.6% and two consecutive sold Q3 prints pull the other way. Net the evidence is roughly balanced, so p_up is 51 and the scaled number (+0.15) is smaller than the findings' sum (+0.2).
language_note: Paxman publishes every release in English and Swedish at the same time on MFN; the Swedish versions carried nothing the English ones did not.

The Swedish-only item was Finansinspektionen's insider register (Förvärv entries, chairman buying at 58.40 on 2026-08-26). It is a regulator record rather than press, and the English wires did not carry it.
Swedish press (Direkt via Placera) carries only outcome telegrams for this name, with no preview, consensus or forum-level information the English sources lacked.
lessons_applied: 'Too small about the move' / thin coverage: abs_move_pct 7.0 -> 7.5 (new numbers, <=2 analysts, $105k/day, observed report-day tail to 23%)
'The finding lands inside what the company already guided': the CMS final rule equals the public proposal, so +0.3 -> +0.2
'A proxy, an inference': FX translation +0.3 -> +0.2 and insider buy +0.2 -> +0.1
'Your own caveat argues against the finding': the opex statement is about Q4/Q1 and the analyst read it the other way, so +0.2 -> +0.1
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' / Q3 beats sold in 2024-25: p_up 52 -> 51
